summary: [PASS] WP-005 is a pure integration verification step — no source files were modified. The review scope is: (1) the build script, and (2) the final state of source files modified across WP-001–WP-004. Build script (scripts/build-personas.js): clean thin wrapper around @mistralys/persona-builder. Pre-build cleans output dirs to prevent stale file accumulation. Post-build syncs package.json version from changelog and regenerates name-mapping.json. --check/--dry-run aliases are correctly handled. Exit code propagation is correct (err.status ?? 1). Source file spot-checks confirm all upstream WP changes are correctly reflected in their final state: (1-planner.md) AC-{NN}: prefix format with zero-padded sequential IDs and inline instruction present; (developer-strict-constraints.md / qa-operational-protocol.md) Verbatim AC Text bullets present and semantically accurate in both; (ledger-bootstrapper.md) Step 3 registers before Step 4 creates files, Single-source AC rule present, AC verification in Step 6 with count-mismatch clarification, Step 5 heading corrected, spec template placeholder updated; (2-project-manager.md / pm-output-format.md) AC content fidelity check present with correct authoritative direction (ledger → spec, never reverse). All AC acceptance criteria were verified by Developer and QA pipelines and remain met. No blocking issues found. No Fix-Forward or Documentation-Forward items required — the code is clean and all prior items were fully resolved by upstream WPs' documentation pipelines.

comments.note: The build script's PERSONA_FILES list (line 89–98) has an inline comment 'This list must stay in sync with the 9 ledger roles in shared/workflow-manifest.json.' This is a known maintenance coupling that carries some future risk. It is not a bug — it is correctly documented in place. The comment is a good practice example of self-documenting maintenance obligations.

No automated content-linting exists for persona Markdown structure (noted by both QA and prior WP reviewers across this project). The build script correctly validates file counts and targets but not structural constraints. This is a cross-cutting architectural observation that spans all four upstream WPs.
